default.notes: Apply for a visa at a Nigerien embassy or consulate before travel — there is no e-visa or tourist visa on arrival. Check the latest security advisories: most of Niger is rated do-not-travel.

groups.notes: ECOWAS-origin citizens keep visa-free entry to Niger after its 2025 withdrawal from the bloc — up to 90 days.
Visa-exempt under bilateral agreement for stays of up to three months.

NE.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Nigerien citizens.

HK.notes: Visa-exempt for short stays of up to 14 days.

AE.notes: UAE ordinary-passport holders can obtain a visa on arrival — confirm current arrangements before travel.

FR.notes: Visa issuance to French nationals has been suspended or heavily restricted since relations broke down after the 2023 coup — contact a Nigerien mission for the current position.

US.notes: Embassy visa required; issuance to US nationals has been slow and unpredictable since the 2023 coup — apply well ahead and check the latest travel advisory.
